name: zmodel_dipool_free_if_unreferenced
description: zModel_DiPool::FreeIfUnreferenced frees unreferenced display-instance contents and returns the slot to the DI free list.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zDi/DI-pool source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4820f0 validates null return 5, referenced-slot return 1, zDi::FreeContents dispatch for zero refCount, clearing the first 0x54 bytes of the slot, computing the pool index from g_zModel_DiPoolBase, linking the slot to g_zModel_DiPoolFreeHeadIndex, decrementing g_zModel_DiPoolInUseCount, updating the free head, and returning 0.
The native ref/free smoke verifies the null and referenced return paths plus the unreferenced free-list update, slot clearing through flags/mode, in-use decrement, and free-head replacement.
